item.title: Inma Sakusei ~Succubus ni Shihai Sareta Gakkou de~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Spilla soft
  • 発売日: 2012-06-13
  • スコア: 5.7299999999999995/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫魔搾精～サキュバスに支配された学校で～
  • 英語名: Inma Sakusei Succubus ni Shihai Sareta Gakkou de

别名

  • Nymph Principal -The School Ruled By Succubus-

あらすじ

July 1999.

Nostradamus predicted the rise of a dreadful power,

but it was just another day for many people. Nobody thought twice

about this month, except one: the protagonist, who one day after

school was suddenly transported to a world of demons.
